tool.title: Translation review page
tool.description: The page a reviewer adjudicates on: `review.html` beside the translation status page, showing every catalogue × locale with its state (machine, flagged, reviewed, stale, official), each string's candidates, and the hash of the catalogue's bytes. Submitting opens GitHub's new-issue form prefilled with a `translation-adjudication/v1` record, or copies the body when it is too long for a URL.

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: The review page, `review.html` beside the translation status page of the published site.

outputs.name: issue
outputs.description: The new-issue form, prefilled; filing it is the adjudication.

remedies.none: The verdict is carried by an issue on the repository that holds the catalogues; with GitHub refused, nothing can be filed. The page still reads, server-rendered, without it.

$comment.comment: `manual`: a person reads and submits it in a browser. `translation-status-viewer` (`translation:status`) is the Tool that writes it.
